read.en: Alphabet rose 0.3% on Oct 13 to $353.78 after touching $358.58 intraday. It is above all its averages: the 5-day ($351.4), 10-day ($347.7), 30-day ($343.9), 200-day ($340.4) and the slightly falling 100-day ($352.1). MACD has been above its signal since Oct 5, Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 8 ($336.8), and RSI is 58.
read.zh: Alphabet 10月13日盘中触及 $358.58，收涨 0.3% 至 $353.78。股价位于所有均线上方：5 日（$351.4）、10 日（$347.7）、30 日（$343.9）、200 日（$340.4）以及小幅下行的 100 日均线（$352.1）。MACD 自 10月5日起位于信号线上方，抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看多（$336.8），RSI 为 58。

read.en: The high poked above the $356–357 resistance but the close fell back below it, so it still caps. Above it are $364 (Sep 22 high, top of the three-week range) and $378 (capped five rallies in Jul–Aug). Support is $352 (100 and 5-day averages), then $344–348 (10 and 30-day averages) and $336 (SAR). A close above $358.6 would target $364.
read.zh: 盘中高点一度突破 $356–357 阻力，但收盘回落至其下方，该阻力仍然有效。其上为 $364（9月22日高点，三周区间上沿）和 $378（7–8月五次压制反弹）。支撑为 $352（100 日和 5 日均线），其次 $344–348（10 日和 30 日均线）及 $336（SAR）。若收盘站上 $358.6，目标看 $364。

r.en: Sep 22 high, top of the 3-week range
